Common questions.

How does AI-assisted estimating work?

Forward a supported enquiry and StoneFlow drafts a schedule for your estimator to review. Your team checks the source and controls what goes into the issued quote.

Which accounting packages are supported?

StoneFlow generates import files for Xero, Sage 50, QuickBooks Online, FreeAgent and KashFlow. Download the file and import it into your accounting package. Live synchronisation is on the roadmap.

Can I see my workflow in a demo?

Yes. Tell us the materials you work with, how your schedules are structured and where you’d like to save time. Arrange a pre-release demo.
